# GZ New Nail (Guangzhou Newnail Cosmetics Co., Ltd.)

> Guangzhou Newnail Cosmetics Co., Ltd. is a verified OEM/ODM nail product contract manufacturer based in Baiyun District, Guangzhou, China. The factory specializes in private label gel polish, Builder in a Bottle (BIAB), tinted rubber base, hard builder gel, acrylic dipping systems, water-permeable Halal polish, and professional salon care lines.

## Official Website
- Homepage: https://gznewnail.com/
- Full Catalog: https://gznewnail.com/products/
- All Product Directory: https://gznewnail.com/products/

## Core Manufacturing & OEM/ODM Capabilities
- **Builder in a Bottle (BIAB) & Rubber Base**: 50+ cover pink/nude shades, medium-to-high elasticity, self-leveling viscosity, 100 bottles low MOQ.
  - Page: https://gznewnail.com/oem/biab-rubber-base-gel-manufacturer.html
- **Water-Permeable & Breathable Halal Nail Polish**: 300+ colors, wudu-friendly permeable polymer matrix, vegan, cruelty-free, laboratory test videos available.
  - Page: https://gznewnail.com/oem/halal-water-permeable-nail-polish-factory.html
- **Low MOQ Private Label Gel Polish**: Custom bottles, screen printing, and color matching from 100 bottles.
  - Page: https://gznewnail.com/oem/low-moq-private-label-gel-polish.html
- **HEMA-Free & TPO-Free Formulation**: Fully compliant with EU Cosmetics Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 and US FDA MoCRA.
  - Page: https://gznewnail.com/oem/hema-free-gel-polish-manufacturer.html
- **Acrylic & Dipping Powder Systems**: EMA monomer liquid, non-yellowing acrylic powder, cover pink ombre, 3-in-1 dipping.
  - Page: https://gznewnail.com/products/acrylic-dipping-system/
- **Bulk & Salon Refills**: 500ml, 1KG, and 1-gallon containers for BIAB, base coat, top coat, builder gel, and acrylic powders.
  - Page: https://gznewnail.com/products/bulk-oem-odm/

## MOQ and Commercial Standards Matrix
- Standard In-Stock Bottles with Custom Logo: 100 bottles (mixed colors from 5-10 pcs/shade).
- Bulk Gels & Polymers: From 1KG / 500ml.
- Custom Molded / Custom-Coated Bottles: 500 to 1,000 bottles.
- Sample Dispatch Time: 3 to 5 business days.
- Bulk Production Lead Time: 7 to 14 business days.
